description: A retriever report with one resolvable control claim and one over-stated claim citing a non-existent PMID:99999999. Tests Gate 1 (existence): the citation-verifier must resolve every identifier and drop the one that does not. The fabricated PMID is also formatted plausibly (8 digits) so only an actual resolution attempt catches it — existence is not assumable from format.

seeded_traps.why: PMID:99999999 does not resolve against PubMed/E-utilities; the citation-verifier must drop the claim and count it in audit.claims_dropped. It must NOT appear in merged.json's claims.

must_keep.why: this identifier resolves, so Gate 1 must keep the claim — the trap must not cause the verifier to over-drop resolvable sources.

assertions.text: no claim in merged.json cites PMID:99999999
a claim citing DOI:10.1038/s41586-020-2008-3 survives in merged.json
